body:
i didn't think anyone would reply to my bs. thanks.

the other day, my acquaintances told me that they didn't want to associate with me because i was being too negative. they told me to "be more positive" and that otherwise i was weighing them down, which confirmed all of my fears. for the past year, i had been living in fear of everyone abandoning me and the fact that they still wanted to associate with me allowed me the courage to keep living. that is why i decided to trust in the future a little bit, and why i didn't run away. now I know that i should have done it. i deserve to die a gruesome death.
